name: io.github.IvanBBaev/instagram-mcp-ai
description: MCP server for the Instagram Platform (Meta Graph API) — professional-account tools.

environmentVariables.name: IG_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Instagram access token for the professional account.

environmentVariables.name: IG_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Instagram professional-account ID. Optional with an Instagram-Login token (calls then address `me`); set it with a Facebook-Login (Page / system-user) token, where `me` is not the Instagram account.

environmentVariables.name: IG_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meta app ID; enables token exchange/refresh, appsecret_proof, and business discovery.

environmentVariables.name: IG_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret; required alongside IG_APP_ID for token refresh and appsecret_proof.

environmentVariables.name: IG_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Auth path: ig-login (Instagram Login, default) or fb-login (Facebook Login). Set it explicitly when both app fields are filled.

environmentVariables.name: IG_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: preview (default, plan only) or apply (execute write tools).

environmentVariables.name: IG_TOOL_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Tool packages to register: core (default), reader, publisher, all, or a comma-separated list.
